fixture.baseCommitRule: copy fixture, initialize Git, commit every fixture file, create the ignored empty .worktrees directory, append the exact declared user draft line to docs/cache-key-notes.md, record its hash and status, then run initial tests before the first prompt

dimensions.criterion: Confirm Git directory, common directory, branch, superproject, status and existing Worktrees are inspected to establish a normal checkout before creating nested isolation.

Confirm an actually available native Worktree tool is preferred, otherwise the ignored .worktrees convention is verified and the exact fix/cache-key-normalization branch and project-local path are created once.
Confirm source-checkout hashes and Git status prove the user's dirty cache-key note is neither copied, overwritten, staged, committed nor removed and no other project byte changes.
Confirm node tests run successfully inside the new Worktree and the response reports its absolute path, branch and exact result before stopping without implementation or cleanup.

hardRejects: overwrites, stages, commits, or removes the user's dirty documentation change
creates a nested Worktree without checking existing isolation and submodule state
uses Git fallback when an actual native Worktree tool is available
skips ignore verification before project-local Git fallback
implements the cache-key feature or cleans up without separate authorization

scoreAnchors.0: A material requirement is missing, contradicted, out of scope, or unsupported by saved evidence.
scoreAnchors.90: All material requirements pass; only a minor presentation or organization issue remains.
scoreAnchors.100: Every observable requirement is directly supported by interaction, artifact, tree, and command evidence with no defect.

rounds.stopCondition: the explicit Worktree creation request is delivered

criticalPath: Inspect repository topology and dirty state, create exactly one authorized isolated Worktree, run its baseline tests, and stop before implementation.
